related_questions.question: Can US citizens travel to Slovakia?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, U.S. citizens can travel to Slovakia. U.S. citizens do not need a visa for stays of up to 90 days for tourism or business purposes within a 180-day period, as Slovakia is part of the Schengen Area. You will need a valid U.S. passport.
